The threshold BLS output is unpredictable before publication yet publicly verifiable afterward. Commitments bind responses to that nonce, blocking precomputation and cross-identity reuse by automated swarms. The anchor, karst, and nadir denote distinct challenge inputs; beacon timing frustrates offline farming, while admission controls are still needed to limit Sybil identities.
